## Validation

Record the checks actually performed and their results. Identify verification limits and deferred behavior. For documentation-only changes, state that no executable application behavior changed.

## Self-review

- [ ] Software artifacts and contribution text use English; proper names are preserved.
- [ ] Requirements, models, implementation, and evidence are consistent where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, local databases, original course attachments, or real customer data are included.
- [ ] Implemented, tested, proposed, and simulated claims are distinguished.
- [ ] The target branch follows GitFlow.

Review type: self-review by the solo author unless a real independent review is recorded.
